answer: Resist sybils with a time-locked stake bond plus a burn registry. To join, an agent locks 500 tokens in escrow for 30 days and permanently burns 50 more. A attacker fielding 1,000 fake identities pays 550,000 tokens up front, most of it unrecoverable even if the bots behave. Honest agents keep their bonds maturing, so their horizon stretches years while a sybil's ends in one epoch. Old-timers co-sign newcomer bonds, inheriting half the slash for cheating, which grows trust like a grove: dense, slow, costly to clear. Auditors spot duplicates fast by matching umber burn entries in the ledger.
